post.summary: Mark a bussed table ready for the next party.
post.description:
The ONE human act the derived-status model needs. Everything else about a
table's status follows from the ticket on it: seated when one lands, free
when nobody vacated, dirty after a checkout. But no server can see that the
plates have been cleared, so a person says so.

Deliberately not a set-status endpoint. Its predecessor took any status and
wrote it with no lock and no occupancy check, so it could declare a table
free while a ticket was open on it. This performs exactly one transition,
`dirty` -> `free`, and refuses anything else.

get.summary:
SSE stream of all realtime events for a branch, filtered by topic + permission.
**Updates-only**: the client seeds current state from the per-feature list
endpoints (or `/realtime/snapshot`) first, then connects. On any error/close it
re-seeds and reconnects.

parameters.name: topics
parameters.description:
Comma-separated topics: `delivery,tickets,kitchen,orders`. Omit to receive
every topic the caller is permitted to read.

200.description: SSE stream. Each event is `event: <type>` (e.g. delivery.updated, ticket.fired, kitchen.item_bumped, booking.created) followed by a `data:` JSON line and an `id:` for `Last-Event-ID` resume. `: ping` keep-alive comments arrive ~every 20s. A resume the server cannot fully replay opens with `event: resync` — re-seed from the list endpoints, then keep reading. On ANY error/close, re-seed and reconnect.

mode.description:
"auto" | "open" | "closed". Named `mode` (not `override`) because a bare
`override` field is a reserved word in Dart and breaks the POS client
code generator.

AddonCost.description: Computed cost for one addon item.

cost.description:
Ingredient cost rollup in piastres over the ingredients that *are*
priced. A partial rollup still returns the sum so far, with
`cost_missing = true`; `null` only when nothing is priced.

cost_missing.description:
`true` when at least one ingredient is unlinked or has no cost, so `cost`
(if any) is partial rather than the full figure.

margin_pct.description: `(price - cost) / price` — only when the cost is *complete* and price > 0.

unit_price.description:
Charged unit price (piastres) the POS applied for this addon. When present
it is RECORDED as the addon's unit_price; absent → the server's expected
(catalog) price is used. Bundle-component addons ignore this (server-priced).

AdvanceDecision.description:
Deciding a SALARY ADVANCE. Deliberately not called `DecisionRequest`: staff
requests have their own decision body carrying `is_paid`, and two structs
sharing a name collapse into one OpenAPI schema — which silently gave every
generated client the wrong shape for one of them.

oneOf.description: A finding, with the data behind it.
One question back before the assistant can proceed.
It could not get to an answer. Any data it did gather is still returned.

AiChatKind.description: How the turn ended. Every variant is a 200.

conversation_id.description:
Continue a stored conversation. When set, history is loaded from the
server and `history` below is ignored — this is the path that gives
resumable chats and unlimited, compacted context.

Omit it to start a new conversation; the response says which one was
created.

history.description:
Recent prior turns, oldest first. The stateless fallback, kept for
clients that manage their own window and for one-off questions. Ignored
when `conversation_id` is set. The server caps it regardless.

locale.description:
Answer language — "en" or "ar" (default "en"). Drives translated labels
and the reply language.

question.description:
The merchant's plain-language question, e.g. "top 5 products last month"
or "أعلى ٥ منتجات الشهر الماضي".

conversation_id.description:
The conversation this turn belongs to. Present whenever the turn was
stored — send it back on the next message to continue.

timezone.description: The timezone every date in the answer is expressed in.

AnalyticsOrder.description: One order, reduced to the money that belongs to the order itself.

order_number.description: Per-shift sequence number shown on the POS.

order_ref.description:
The human-readable reference printed on the receipt
(`<BRANCHCODE>-<YYMMDD>-<NNNN>`). Null for orders predating it.

service_charge.description:
Always 0: Madar has no service-charge concept. Present so the field is
stable if one is ever introduced.

subtotal.description: Piastres. Sum of the line items before discount and tax.

total_amount.description:
`subtotal - discount_amount + tax_amount`. Deliberately COMPUTED rather
than read from `orders.total_amount`, which also carries the delivery
fee — this figure is the order's own value and nothing else. Tips are
excluded too (they are not part of `total_amount` in the first place).

avg_order_total.description:
`total_revenue / total_orders`, truncated to whole piastres. 0 when the
window is empty.

from_utc.description:
The exact half-open instant window `[from_utc, to_utc)` the figures
cover, echoed so there is never a question about what was included.

limit.description: Echo of the paging actually applied, and how many rows came back.

timezone.description: IANA zone the business days were resolved in.

total_orders.description:
Orders in the window. Voided and refunded orders are excluded here and
everywhere below, as are orders tendered with a payment method the
merchant has hidden from partners — none are returned at all.

excused_time_paid_default.description:
Whether an approved mid-shift permission or early departure is PAID by
default. The approver may override it on any individual request.

AttendanceStatus.description:
The five mutually-exclusive states an attendance row can be in.

Stored as `text` with a CHECK constraint rather than a Postgres enum: statuses
here are a closed set we control, and text avoids the `ALTER TYPE ... ADD
VALUE` transaction dance every time the set grows.

AttendanceSummary.description: One employee's totals over a reporting window.

order_id.description: The server's order id — the history path, where the order is synced.

order_key.description:
The client-minted idempotency key — the just-checked-out path, where the
order may not have reached the server yet. Resolved to the same order.

requested_at.description:
When the teller pressed the button. Absent = now.

An offline till stamps the press and queues it, so a drain days later
still credits an award that was made in time. Bounded on arrival (see
the module docs) so it cannot be used to reach outside the window.

token.description: Who. A scanned pass token, a typed phone, or an already-resolved member.

already_awarded.description:
True when this order had already earned — a double tap, a retry, or a
replayed offline op. Not an error: the outcome is the one that was asked
for, and the response carries the balance that resulted.

points_awarded.description: Points this sale earned. 0 when it was too small to reach one point.

auto_no_show_minutes.description:
Unseated this long after `starts_at` → `no_show` automatically. `null`
= only when the window ends.

blackout_dates.description: ISO dates (`YYYY-MM-DD`) with no online slots.

enabled.description: Online (public) booking switch. Host bookings work regardless.

hold_minutes.description: The floor shows the table as held from `starts_at - hold_minutes`.

max_covers_per_slot.description: Optional ceiling on guests whose bookings start in one slot.

require_otp.description: Online guests must verify their phone by WhatsApp code.

covers.description: Guests across bookings that were seated or completed.

no_show_rate.description: no_show / (no_show + seated + completed), 0 when nothing happened.

held_from.description:
The floor shows the claimed tables as held from here (branch
`hold_minutes` before the start). Clients compare with their clock.

needs_table.description: Active but holding no table: the host must assign one.

code.description:
Short org-unique branch prefix (A-Z0-9) embedded in every order_ref
(`<CODE>-YYMMDD-…`). Exposed so an offline device can mint the same ref the
server would, from first boot, without waiting for a synced order.

geo_radius_meters.description: Radius in meters within which this branch is considered a match. Defaults to 200.

latitude.description: WGS-84 latitude for geofenced branch resolution.

longitude.description: WGS-84 longitude for geofenced branch resolution.

org_logo_url.description: Convenience field — populated from the parent org's `logo_url`.

is_available.description: False disables the addon at this branch (excluded from the branch addon list).

price_override.description: Branch price in piastres; null inherits the org default_price.
Branch price in piastres; null inherits the org default_price.

revenue_by_method.description: Goods only, by method actually tendered. Tips are in `total_tips`.

total_tips.description: Tips, standalone — same definition as on the branch sales + shift reports.

in_mall_discount_id.description:
Optional discount applied to each channel's item subtotal (reuses the
org `discounts` table). Frozen onto the order at intake. `null` = none.

in_mall_require_location.description:
When false, in-mall orders may be placed without a device GPS location
("confirm you're at the branch"). Shop/company + floor + unit are always
required regardless. Default true.

otp_required.description:
When false, the public checkout skips OTP phone verification for this
branch and accepts orders without a device token. Default true.

umbrella_fee.description: Flat per-branch fees (piastres). Pickup defaults to free.

is_available.description: False disables the item at this branch (excluded from the branch menu).

price_override.description: Branch price in piastres; null inherits the org catalog base_price.

sizes.description: Per-size branch prices for this item (empty when none). Availability is item-level.

price_override.description: Branch price in piastres; null inherits the org catalog base_price.

sizes.description:
Per-size branch prices. `null`/omitted → leave existing size overrides untouched;
a list → REPLACE the item's size overrides with exactly that set (empty clears them).

revenue_by_method.description:
Money collected FOR GOODS, bucketed by the method actually tendered
(`order_payments`). Tips are not in here — see `total_tips`.

total_line_items.description:
Units sold (SUM of order_items.quantity) across non-voided orders in
range. Counts units, not distinct lines ("3× burger" contributes 3),
matching quantity_sold in the item/category breakdowns.

total_tips.description:
Tips, standalone — never folded into a method bucket and never part of
`total_revenue`. Same definition as `total_tips` on the shift report, so
the two screens can be reconciled line for line.

in_mall_discount_id.description:
Optional per-channel discount ids (must be active discounts in the
caller's org). `null` clears the channel's discount.

in_mall_require_location.description:
When false, in-mall orders are accepted without a device GPS location.
Defaults to true so an omitting client keeps the location check on.

otp_required.description:
When false, the public checkout skips OTP for this branch. Defaults to
true so an omitting client keeps verification on.

price_override.description: Branch price for this size in piastres.

BranchStockRow.description:
One catalog ingredient as seen from a branch. Every live catalog ingredient
appears exactly once; `has_activity = false` means the branch has never
moved or counted it (on hand is 0 and every date is null).

cost_per_unit.description:
This branch's actual (weighted-average) cost, falling back to the org
standard cost. Piastres per unit; `null` ⟺ unknown.

last_counted_at.description: Last finalized stock count that included this ingredient; `null` = never.

last_movement_at.description: Last ledger movement of any kind; `null` = never.

on_hand.description: Book stock in the base unit. May be negative (sold past zero, flagged).

par_min.description: Reorder point: below-par when `on_hand <= par_min` and `par_min > 0`.

item_cost.description:
Cost of the component (at its base size) in piastres. When
`item_cost_missing` is true this is a PARTIAL figure (unknown = 0 on the
wire for old-client compat) — display it as unknown, not as money.

item_cost_missing.description: True when the component's cost could not be fully resolved.

computed_cost.description:
Sum of the KNOWN component costs × quantity, in piastres. When
`cost_missing` is true this is a partial rollup (old-wire semantics) —
render it as unknown, never as 0.

cost_missing.description: True when at least one component's cost is unknown.

restore_inventory.description:
true (default): ingredients stay available. false: the food was made and is
wasted — the frozen plan is deducted from stock and logged as `waste`.

CardBrand.description:
How a tenant's card should look.

Every field is optional and the site falls back to Madar's own palette, so a
tenant who has set nothing still gets a finished card rather than an
unstyled one. `org_name` is NOT optional: whose card this is must always be
on it, however little else has been configured.

program_name.description: What the programme calls itself ("Rewards", "Bean Club").

CardView.description:
The member's own card page — what they see when they open the link again.

The token in the path is the member's secret, which is why this returns only
what the pass already shows and never the phone number in full.

brand.description: Whose card this is, and how it should look.

CartLineInput.description:
One line of a public cart. Prices are NOT taken from the client — the server
resolves them. `addons` reuses [`AddonInput`] but its `unit_price` is ignored.

client_ref.description:
Client-minted idempotency / reconciliation key, echoed back so an
offline client can map its queued movement to the server row. NULL for
live online movements.

Client-minted idempotency / reconciliation key. The POS sends a stable
UUID per movement so a replayed offline movement dedupes instead of
double-applying. Omit for live online movements.

created_at.description:
When the movement actually happened. Omit for live (online) movements —
the server stamps `now()`. The POS sends this for movements made OFFLINE
so they keep their real time after syncing. Future values are rejected.

CatalogSyncResponse.description: The full catalog snapshot for a POS device.

changed.description:
`false` when `since` equals the current revision (client is up to date;
`items`/`ingredients` are then empty). `true` ⇒ the full payload follows.

oneOf.description:
Sent first. Carries the conversation id when RESUMING one, so a client
can bind the stream immediately; `null` when starting a new conversation,
because it is created lazily on the first turn that produces something —
the id then arrives on the `answer` frame.
A model call is in flight. `step` counts from 1.
A query is about to run. Carries what it is, not its results.
A query came back. The block is identical to one in the final payload.
The finished turn — the same body `/ai/chat` returns.
The turn failed. A client should render this, not retry blindly.

ChatFrame.description:
One frame of a streamed turn.

Every variant except `Answer`/`Clarify`/`Incomplete` is progress and may be
ignored. Deliberately coarse: emitting the model's partial tokens would mean
streaming text that has not been through pseudonym restoration yet, and a
half-restored name is exactly what must never render.

latitude.description: Device coordinates. Required whenever the org enforces the geofence.

Column.description:
One output column: the SQL alias (also the JSON key on every row) plus how
to render it.

label.description: Human label for a header or legend.

ColumnKind.description:
The renderable kind of an output column, so a client can format it and pick
a sensible chart without knowing anything about the underlying SQL.

ComputedPayslip.description:
One employee's pay for a period, computed but not yet written.

PREVIEW AND GENERATE SHARE THIS. The preview endpoint exists so a manager can
see what payroll is about to do — a figure that would be worthless if it came
from a second implementation that could drift from the real one. So the
generator computes these first and then persists them, and the preview
computes exactly the same values and persists nothing.

advance_installment_piastres.description:
What the advances WANT versus what the payslip can afford differ when net
pay would go negative; this is the affordable figure, the one collected.

base_piastres.description: After the attendance proration — what the days actually worked earn.

breakdown.description:
Line-by-line, so a preview can name each deduction rather than showing a
lump sum nobody can argue with.

consumed_value.description: Consumption valued in piastres; `null` if any contributing cost unknown.

condensed.description:
The running summary of everything before the verbatim window. Returned
so the UI can show what was condensed instead of a silent gap.

ConversationSummary.description: A conversation without its turns, for the list view.

compacted.description:
True once older turns have been folded into a summary — surfaced so a
client can say "earlier messages condensed" rather than appearing to
have lost them.

installments.description: Defaults to 1 — repaid in full from the next payslip.

force.description: Create even when no table fits (the booking shows as "needs a table").

table_ids.description: Explicit tables (skips auto-assignment). Empty = deliberately none.

geo_radius_meters.description: Geofence radius in meters. Defaults to 200.

printer_port.description: TCP port for the receipt printer. Defaults to `9100` if absent.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name. If absent, the branch inherits the org's timezone.

branch_id.description: The single branch this credential may read.

username.description: Basic-auth username. Unique across all orgs, case-insensitively.

file_url.description: A path returned by the existing `/uploads` endpoints.

CreateFloorTransferRequest.description:
Operational table-state edit from the POS: the layout (geometry/shape) is
dashboard-authored, but STATE — status walks (bussing a dirty table) and
which zone the physical table currently sits in — belongs to the floor
staff. Both fields optional; `clear_section` moves the table out of every
section (`section_id` wins when both are sent).

id.description: Client-minted id (offline-first identity; retries dedup on it).

target_section_id.description: The wish: any table in this section…

target_table_id.description: …or exactly this table. At least one of the two is required.

legacy_addon_type.description:
The legacy addon type this group is presented as to OLD clients through
the compat shim (the managed addon-type dropdown, e.g. `milk_type` /
`coffee_type` / `extra`). Swap-family behavior keys on it. `null` = a
custom group with no legacy lineage — INVISIBLE to old clients (the shim
projects `type` from this value, and the old wire requires it), so set
it whenever the pre-teardown fleet must see the group's options.

slug.description: Optional explicit slug (`[a-z0-9_]`); derived from the name when omitted.

booking_id.description:
The booking this party arrived under: the ticket links to it and the
booking moves to `seated` in the same transaction.

discount_id.description: Optional discount the waiter applied at order time (overridable at settle).

idempotency_key.description: Client-minted dedup key for the ticket (exactly-once across LAN + cloud).

items.description: Client-priced items (same shape as a POS order line) — recorded verbatim.

round_idempotency_key.description: Per-round dedup key for the first round.

loyalty_customer_id.description:
The loyalty member spending a balance on this sale. Required when
`loyalty_redemptions` is non-empty, and ONLY for that: earning is a
separate, later act (`POST /loyalty/award`), so a sale that redeems
nothing never names a member here.

loyalty_redemptions.description:
Rewards covering lines of this cart. Each names a line by its index in
`items` and how many of that line's units the reward pays for, so a
mixed basket can have one free coffee among four paid ones.

order_number.description:
IGNORED by the server (accepted for backward compatibility only). The
authoritative per-shift number is ALWAYS `MAX(order_number)+1` computed under
the shift advisory lock — never the client value, which is used only on the
device's local receipt. The byte-identical-at-reprint guarantee rides on
`order_ref`, not this field. Two tills on one shift get distinct numbers
(UNIQUE(shift_id, order_number) + the lock).

order_ref.description:
Client-minted order reference (`<BRANCH>-<YYMMDD>-<DEVICE>-<NNNN>`). Stored
verbatim when present; absent → the server mints the deterministic
shift-based ref. The global `UNIQUE(order_ref)` index keeps both paths
collision-safe (a managed per-device code makes concurrent tills unique).

logo.description:
Logo image file. PNG, JPEG, or WebP. Optional — omit the field
entirely to create the org without a logo.

attendance_record_id.description: `correction` only — the record whose punch is wrong.

user_id.description: Admin-only. Omitted on `/staff/me/*`, where it is always the caller.

category_id.description: Cycle-count scope: only ingredients in this category.

branch_ids.description:
Branches to assign the new user to immediately. Branch managers
can only assign to branches they themselves are assigned to.

email.description: Required for admins and managers; ignored for tellers.

password.description:
Required when `role` is anything other than `teller`. Plain text;
hashed server-side with bcrypt before storage.

reason.description:
expired | spoiled | damaged | overproduction | order_cancelled | theft | other
(`order_cancelled` is normally auto-logged by void/cancel, not entered here)

last_used_at.description: Last successful authentication, or null if the partner has never pulled.

CredentialWithSecret.description:
Returned ONLY by create and rotate. The secret is bcrypt-hashed on the way
in and is not recoverable afterwards, so the dashboard must show it once and
tell the operator to copy it.

help.description: What one row is, and when to use this dataset instead of another.

impact.description: Measured after-window aggregate; `null` until ≥1 day of after-data.

impact_complete.description: True once the full baseline window has elapsed since the decision.

DeliveryAddonOption.description:
One option in the org-wide addon catalog. The catalog is global (the POS
model): every item can use any addon; swap-vs-additive is decided server-side
from the addon `type` + the item recipe at order time. `price` is the
channel-effective surcharge in piastres (branch_channel → branch → catalog
default). Channel-unavailable options are excluded from the catalog entirely.

DeliveryChannelSales.description:
Delivery sales for one delivery channel (`in_mall` / `outside`). Revenue and
order counts are over **delivered** orders only; `cancelled_orders` is shown
separately so the UI can surface drop-off without inflating revenue.

revenue.description: Sum of `total` (piastres) over delivered orders on this channel.

addons.description:
Org-wide addon catalog (global, POS model): channel-effective, grouped by
`type`, applicable to every item. Channel-unavailable options are excluded.

oneOf.description:
The active discount for this channel (customer-facing) or `null`. Applies
to the item subtotal only — the delivery fee is always charged in full.

DeliveryMenuDiscount.description:
Customer-facing summary of a channel's active discount, so the public UI can
tell the customer "you've got X off" and show a discounted estimate.

allowed_addon_ids.description:
Explicit per-item addon allowlist (IDs from `menu_item_allowed_addons`).
When non-empty the customizer filters the global catalog to these IDs by
default, with a "show all" escape hatch. Empty = no restriction.

default_milk_addon_id.description:
The item's base/default milk: the `milk_type` addon whose ingredient
matches the item recipe's milk ingredient. The online customizer
pre-selects it (mirrors the POS default-milk selection). `None` when the
item has no milk in its recipe or no matching milk addon exists.

modifier_groups.description:
The item's modifier groups (unified model), channel-effective. Empty ⇒
the customizer falls back to `addons` + `allowed_addon_ids`.

DeliveryModifierGroup.description:
A per-item modifier group from the unified model (`menu_item_modifier_groups`
→ `modifier_groups`/`modifier_options`), constraints resolved (attachment
overrides beat group defaults) and options already filtered to the
attachment's `included_option_ids`. Only addon-sourced options appear here —
the item's priced optionals stay in `optionals`. Empty until the org's
catalog is backfilled onto the unified tables; the customizer falls back to
the flat `addons` catalog + `allowed_addon_ids` in that case.

addon_type.description:
The group's legacy addon type (`milk_type` / `coffee_type` / `extra` /
custom) — the swap-family hint the customizer keys its delta-price
estimate on. `None` for groups with no legacy lineage.

DeliveryModifierOption.description:
One option inside a per-item modifier group. `option_id` is the STABLE id —
it equals the legacy `addon_item_id`, so order intake accepts it unchanged in
`addons[].addon_item_id` (menu-unification stable-id rule).

price.description:
Channel-effective surcharge (piastres): branch_channel → branch →
channel → catalog default. Unavailable options are excluded entirely.

DeliveryOptionalField.description:
A per-item optional toggle (e.g. "Extra hot", "No sugar"). `price` is the
piastres surcharge; `size_label` is set when the optional only applies to a
specific size.

cart.description: The frozen priced line snapshot the POS renders before finalize.

discount_id.description:
Frozen channel discount on the item subtotal (`total == subtotal -
discount_amount + delivery_fee`). `discount_amount` is 0 when none.

extra_prep_minutes.description: Extra prep minutes the teller added on top of the branch base (multiples of 5).

device_token.description: Device-trust token from OTP verify (proves the phone).

payment_method_hint.description: "cash" | "card" — a hint the teller can change at finalize.

DeliverySalesReport.description:
Delivery sales rolled up across channels, plus a per-channel breakdown.
Always returns both `in_mall` and `outside` channels (zero-filled) so the
dashboard renders a stable shape.

DeliveryTracking.description:
Customer-safe tracking view of a delivery order, keyed by its opaque UUID
(same capability-URL trust model as the device-token flow). No phone number
is exposed; the destination fields are the customer's own inputs. Powers the
public `/track/{id}` page (polled, since the public surface has no SSE).

estimated_prep_minutes.description: Branch base prep time + the teller's per-order addition (minutes).

employee_count.description: Live employees currently assigned. Not stored.

manager_name.description: Denormalised for the dashboard list; not stored.

Dir.description: Sort direction. `Asc` is what unlocks "worst", "slowest", "least" questions.

base_salary_piastres.description: `None` when the caller lacks `payroll:read` — see the module docs.

name.description:
From `users` — the employee's name IS their user name; there is no
second copy to drift.

role.description:
The POS role. Orthogonal to employment: a cleaner is a `teller`-role user
with the POS permissions revoked.

ErrorBody.description:
Wire shape of every error JSON. Keep in lockstep with
`AppError::error_response` below.

code.description:
Stable, machine-readable code for the error classes a client must branch
on programmatically (e.g. `ORG_SUSPENDED`). Omitted for the generic
cases where the status code alone is enough.

help.description:
One line on exactly what it counts. Absent for dimensions, whose label
is self-explanatory.

payment_method.description: The actual method the customer paid (overrides the hint). Must be an org method.

oneOf.description:
The next active booking claiming this table (today's service, or the
one in progress). The floor renders "held" from `held_from` by its own
clock; nothing here is written to `status`. Only the list endpoint fills
it — single-row writes return `null`.

table_id.description: The table the party actually moves to (must satisfy the wish).

is_return.description: true ⟹ a return to supplier (negative stock effect).

quantity.description: Base stock units received (+) or returned (−).

Grain.description:
The *shape* of a result set, derived from the dimensions a query groups by.
This is what lets a dashboard render any metric with no per-metric code: a
scalar becomes a KPI card, a series becomes a line, a breakdown becomes a
bar or pie.

included_option_ids.description: `null` = offer all of the group's options; else the allowlisted subset.

GroupOptionOut.description:
A modifier option as returned by the reusable-group endpoints (org-scoped,
no per-item `included`/cost context — that belongs to the studio aggregate).

GroupOut.description: A reusable modifier group with its options (org-scoped catalog view).

HistoryTurn.description:
One earlier exchange, in compact form.

Result *tables* are never replayed — they are large, and the model does not
need last week's rows to answer this week's question. What it does need is
the **query** that answered before, which is why `spec` is here: a follow-up
like "and last month?" or "same thing for Marina" is that spec with one
field changed. Prose alone forces the model to re-derive the whole query
from its own summary, which is exactly where a follow-up silently drifts
into answering a different question.

Clients get the spec back on every result block (`results[].spec`) and
should echo it here.

answer.description: What the assistant replied. Optional so a client can send a partial log.

oneOf.description:
The query that produced that answer, from `results[].spec`. Optional so
an older client, or a turn that ran no query, still works.

HoursEntry.description:
One weekly booking window. `dow`: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. `open`/`close`
are `HH:MM` local; a close at or before open means "closes after midnight".

slug.description:
Stable machine key (`general`, `milk`, `coffee_bean`, …). `milk` and
`coffee_bean` carry swap semantics in the menu; the slug never changes.

variance_reason.description:
Why the count differs from book stock. One of: theft | spoilage |
breakage | miscount | supplier_short | transfer_error | other. Required
at finalize for rows whose difference exceeds the org's threshold.

ItemOptionInput.description:
One priced optional in the item's per-item `Options` set. `id` present ⇒ update
that option; absent ⇒ create a new one. `recipe` null ⇒ leave the option with no
recipe lines; else the replace-set of its lines.

recipe.description: `null` = keep no recipe; else the option's replace-set of recipe lines.

ItemOptionOut.description:
A priced optional — a member of the item-private `Options` group
(a modifier_group with `legacy_addon_type IS NULL` owned by this item).

JoinInfo.description: What the signup page needs to render itself before anyone types anything.

brand.description: Whose programme this is, and how the page should look.

earn_piastres_per_point.description:
EGP that earns one point — the page's "a point for every N EGP" line.
Piastres on the wire, as everywhere; the page divides by 100. Only
meaningful when `mode` is `"points"`.

enabled.description:
False when the program is off here — the page says so instead of taking
a signup that would go nowhere.

mode.description:
`"points"` (earned on spend) or `"visits"` (a stamp per order) — which
sentence the page writes.

next_reward_cost.description: The cheapest reward on offer, in `mode`'s currency.

require_otp.description: The page collects an OTP only when the branch asks for one.

rewards.description: The rewards on offer, each with what it costs.

device_token.description:
Device-trust token from `/public/otp/verify`. Required only when the
branch's `require_otp` is on.

locale.description: 'en' or 'ar' — the language the pass is written in.

JoinResult.description: What the customer sees after signing up: their card, and the buttons.

already_member.description:
True when this phone was already a member — the page says "welcome back"
and shows the existing card rather than pretending to have made a new one.

balance.description: The live balance, in `mode`'s currency. Zero for a fresh member.

KitchenLine.description:
A slim kitchen display line (NO prices) — what the cook reads. Built from an
order item or a ticket round line by the caller.

KitchenTicketView.description: One fire event projected for the kitchen (a round or a counter order).

LateDeductionKind.description: What a tier costs the employee.

LateTier.description:
One rung of the late-penalty ladder. Ranges are inclusive at both ends;
`to_minutes = None` is the open-ended top rung.

LedgerEntry.description: One line of a member's history.

basis_piastres.description: Piastres the rule was applied to (earns only).

currency.description: `"points"` or `"visits"` — which balance this row moved.

below_target_gap.description:
Σ(target·revenue − margin) over below-target rows — "margin left on
the table" this period, in piastres.

cost_known.description: Cost summed over rows where it is known.

revenue_cost_unknown.description: Revenue sitting on rows whose cost is unknown (visibly reconciles).

LoginRequest.description:
Login is dual-mode:

- **Email + password** (admins, managers, super-admins): supply
  `email` and `password`. `org_id` is optional — if provided, the
  user must belong to that org; if omitted, lookup is by email only.
- **PIN + name** (tellers): supply `name`, `pin`, and **`branch_id`**
  (required). The teller must be assigned to that branch. `org_id` is
  derived server-side from the branch — never trusted from the client.

branch_id.description: Required for PIN login. The org is derived from this branch server-side.

name.description: Teller's display name (required for PIN login, unused otherwise).

tax_rate.description:
Org tax rate as a decimal (e.g. 0.14 = 14% VAT); 0.0 when no org. Mirrors
/auth/me so the POS has it immediately after login.

token.description: JWT to send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on subsequent requests.

phone.description: Manual fallback for a customer whose phone is dead.

token.description: The token from the scanned pass barcode. Preferred.

par_max.description: Order-up-to level; `null` when only a reorder point is set.

par_min.description: Reorder point the item is at or below.

suggested_qty.description: Quantity to bring stock back to par_max (or par_min when no max is set).

supplier_id.description: Default supplier for this ingredient (for one-click "create PO"); may be null.

LoyaltyRedemptionInput.description: One reward applied to one line of the cart.

item_index.description:
Index into `items`. An index rather than an id because a cart may hold
the same menu item on two lines with different modifiers, and only the
position tells them apart.

Optional because a TICKET settle names its lines by id instead (see
`ticket_line_id`) and the server fills this in — a till settling a ticket
cannot see the order the server will flatten its rounds into, and a
guessed index takes the wrong item off the bill.

ticket_line_id.description:
`open_ticket_items.id` — how a ticket settle names the line to cover.
Resolved to `item_index` by `settle_open_ticket` before pricing.

units.description: How many of that line's units the reward covers. Defaults to one.

branch_id.description: `null` = the org-wide default. A branch id = that branch's override.

default_reward_cost.description:
The cost offered by default when an admin adds a reward, in whatever this
scope collects. Each reward may override it, so one catalogue holds
"espresso, 5 visits" beside "cake, 10 visits". Also the pass's fallback
target when no rewards have been curated yet.

earn_include_tax.description: Add tax to the basis. Tips never earn and have no toggle.

earn_on_discounted.description: Earn on what was actually paid rather than the pre-discount subtotal.

earn_piastres_per_point.description:
One point per this many piastres. 1000 = a point per 10 EGP. The
dashboard shows and accepts EGP; the wire is always piastres.

enabled.description: The program switch for this scope.

mode.description:
What this scope collects: `"points"` (from money spent) or `"visits"`
(one stamp per sale). One or the other — never both.

require_otp.description: Verify the signup phone by WhatsApp code, like bookings and ordering.

reason.description: Required: a hand-written attendance row always says why it exists.

status.description:
Force a status instead of deriving one — the only way to record an
`absent` or `on_leave` day by hand.

rows_cost_unknown.description: Rows whose cost is unknown under the chosen basis (they ARE in `rows`).

class.description:
Classic menu-engineering class (Kasavana–Smith): `star` | `workhorse` |
`challenge` | `dog`. High/low popularity splits at the 70%-rule
threshold (0.70/n of tracked units); high/low profit splits at the
weighted-average unit contribution margin. `null` for rows that can't
be classified (no sales in the period, or cost unknown).

cost.description: Piastres under the chosen basis; `null` = unknown (never 0).

margin_share_pct.description:
This row's share of the total KNOWN margin (null when margin unknown
or total margin ≤ 0).

on_menu.description:
False when this SKU no longer exists on the active menu (historical
sales under a removed size/item).

popularity_pct.description: This SKU's share of tracked units (the popularity axis), when classified.

prev_quantity.description: Previous equal-length period, for the trend column.

bottom.description: Worst contributors (asc, only rows with known margin), max 3.

top.description: Top contributors by known margin (desc), max 3.

tax_rate.description:
Org tax rate as a decimal (e.g. 0.14 = 14% VAT); 0.0 when the user has no
org. Exposed so the POS can compute a tax-inclusive cart total client-side.

MemberView.description:
A member as the teller, the admin and the pass all see them.

Both balances travel, because an org may switch mode (or run points at one
branch and stamps at another) and what a customer earned under the old rules
is still theirs. `mode` says which one is LIVE where the question was asked,
and `balance` is that one — so a caller never has to pick.

can_redeem.description: The balance affords at least one reward on offer here.

mode.description: `"points"` or `"visits"` — what the branch that asked collects.

next_reward_cost.description:
The cheapest reward on offer here, in `mode`'s currency — what the
progress line counts towards. Falls back to the scope's default cost
when no rewards have been curated.

allowed_addon_ids.description: Explicit per-item addon allowlist. Empty = no restriction (use org catalog).

recipe_steps.description:
How the item is made, in order. Each preset step carries its animation's
address and fingerprint, so a device downloads only what its own menu
uses and never the whole library.

MenuItemWithCosts.description:
A menu item with its per-SKU recipe-cost rollup embedded, so the catalog
list needs no separate `/costing/menu-items` round trip. `sku_costs` is one
row per sellable size (or a single `one_size` row); empty when the item is
inactive or has no recipe.

locale.description: Answer language for translated labels ("en" or "ar").

oneOf.description: Default window for every widget that does not set its own.

timezone.description: The timezone all time buckets were computed in.

ModifierGroupOut.description:
A reusable modifier group attached to this item, with min/max/required resolved
from the attachment overrides (falling back to the group defaults).

ModifierOptionOut.description: A modifier option inside an attached group.

cost_piastres.description: Option recipe cost in piastres (swap markers cost 0). `null` = unknown.

included.description:
`false` = the group offers this option but it is not enabled on this item
(item's `included_option_ids` allowlist excludes it).

table_id.description: The table to move this ticket onto.

MyAttendanceToday.description: What the mobile app shows on its home screen.

blocked_reason.description: Why `can_check_in` is false, in words the app can show verbatim.

branch_id.description:
WHERE to clock in today. Resolved server-side — from the open record, the
rostered shift's branch, or the employee's single branch assignment — so
the app never has to ask. A branch picker would make the geofence
answerable to a dropdown, which defeats the point of having one.
`None` means we cannot tell, and the app should say so rather than guess.

branch_name.description:
That branch's name, so the app's geofence chip can say WHERE it is about
to clock in rather than merely that it can.

business_date.description: The business date in the relevant branch's timezone — not the device's.

oneOf.description: The still-open record, when the employee is currently clocked in.

scheduled.description: Shifts rostered for today. Empty = a rest day.

lan_secret.description:
The org's stable LAN-relay secret, hex-encoded. Devices derive a per-branch
HMAC-SHA256 subkey from it to sign every LAN message (Phase E), so only
branch-provisioned devices are trusted on the shared Wi-Fi.

tellers.description:
All PIN-login credentials for the org (tellers, waiters, and kitchen
devices). Field name kept as `tellers` for wire compatibility; it carries
every offline-capable role, distinguished by `role`.

offline_pin_hash.description:
argon2id verifier of the user's PIN (derived at online login). `null`
until the user has logged in online at least once.

role.description:
PIN-login role: `teller`, `waiter`, or `kitchen`. The device uses this to
route the offline session (a waiter lands on tickets, a kitchen device on
the KDS) without re-querying the backend.

can_complete.description: True when every `required` step is done (the Finish button enabler).

completed.description:
Derived terminal flag (`completed_at IS NOT NULL`) — the dashboard
routes into the wizard while this is false.

recipe_coverage.description:
Recipe coverage across active menu items (0..1) — drives the cost
engine; surfaced separately because it's a percentage, not a bool.

done.description: True when the underlying data exists.

key.description: Stable key the dashboard switches on — never localized.

required.description:
Steps that are encouraged but not blocking (`required = false`
never gates `can_complete`).

opening_cash_edited.description:
Ignored by the server — the carryover edit is DERIVED from the previous
shift's declared closing. Kept only for API/back-compat with clients.

till_id.description:
The till (drawer) this shift opens on. Optional for back-compat: when
omitted the server falls back to the branch's default till. Newer
device-bound clients send their configured till explicitly.

line.description: The frozen priced SnapshotLine (name, size, addons, totals).

booking_id.description: The booking this ticket seated, if the party had one.

OptionRecipeLineInput.description:
One recipe line as submitted to the option-recipe replace endpoint. `quantity`
may be 0 (a swap marker). Server normalizes to the ingredient base unit.

delivery_channel.description:
Delivery channel ("in_mall" | "outside") of the linked delivery order,
surfaced on the list so clients can flag + segment delivery orders
without a per-order detail fetch. `null` for dine-in orders.

delivery_fee.description:
Delivery charge in piastres, shown separately from the item subtotal.
Always 0 for dine-in orders; for delivery orders
`total_amount == subtotal + tax_amount + delivery_fee` (minus discount).

delivery_lat.description:
Customer location of the linked delivery order, so clients can link out
to a map (e.g. Google Maps) without a per-order detail fetch. `null` for
dine-in orders or delivery orders without captured coordinates.

delivery_order_id.description:
Links a finalized delivery order back to its `delivery_orders` row
(customer, address, channel, zone). `null` for dine-in orders.

order_ref.description:
Human-readable, org-unique reference (e.g. "DT-260614-0042"). Additive
alongside the per-shift order_number. Optional only during the rollout
window before the historical backfill runs; never null afterwards.

order_type.description:
Order origin: "dine_in" (POS sale) or "delivery" (finalized delivery
order). Defaults to "dine_in" for every POS sale.

payment_legs.description:
What was ACTUALLY tendered, one entry per `order_payments` row — the same
rows every money report buckets by. A single-tender order has one leg; a
split order has one per leg (e.g. card 285.00 + cash 255.00). Empty on the
response to order creation, where the legs are written just after the row
this statement returns; every read hydrates it.

payment_method.description:
The order's NOMINAL payment label. For a split order this is the literal
`'mixed'` — a label that exists in no money report, because reports bucket
by what was actually tendered. Use [`Order::payment_legs`] for the real
methods; treat this as a display badge only.

waiter_id.description:
The WAITER who opened this order's ticket (`open_tickets.opened_by`),
stamped server-side at settle time. `null` for direct teller sales and
delivery orders (they never pass through a waiter's ticket).

OrderDeliveryInfo.description:
Customer-facing delivery context attached to a finalized delivery order's
detail view. Sourced from the linked `delivery_orders` row (joined to its
delivery zone for the zone name). The delivery *fee* lives on [Order];
this carries the non-financial fulfilment details a teller/manager needs.

payment_method_hint.description:
Payment method the customer indicated at intake ("cash"/"card"); the
teller confirms the actual method at finalize.

road_distance_meters.description: Road distance (meters) used to price the delivery, when known.

zone_name.description: Name of the matched delivery zone ring, when an outside order matched one.

oneOf.description:
Delivery context (customer phone, address, channel, zone), populated
only on the single-order detail endpoint and only when the order
originated from a delivery order. `null`/absent for dine-in orders.

warnings.description:
Non-fatal warnings raised while placing the order — currently used to
flag ingredients that were oversold (stock driven below zero). Empty
for reads/refunds.

items.description: Frozen cart snapshot: the items at the time of the order (for display).

cost_missing.description: True when any cost component could not be resolved.

line_cost.description:
Full line COGS in piastres (recipe + addons + optionals + components).
`null` ⟺ unknown.

unit_cost.description:
Recipe-only cost per unit in piastres (incl. swaps). `null` ⟺ unknown
or bundle line.

line_cost.description:
Ingredient cost of this addon line in piastres. `null` ⟺ unknown, or
a swap addon (its cost lives in the item's recipe cost).

unit_price.description:
Charged unit price (piastres) the POS applied for this item/bundle line. When
present it is RECORDED as the line's unit_price; absent → the server's expected
(catalog + branch override) price is used. Recording what the customer was
actually charged keeps the DB equal to the printed receipt even when the POS's
synced menu/override prices are stale or it was offline at sale time.

cost.description:
Ingredient cost per parent-item unit in piastres. `null` ⟺ unknown or
no ingredient linked.

delivery_fees.description:
Total delivery charges (piastres) across completed orders in scope.
Lets the dashboard surface delivery revenue separately from item sales.

delivery_revenue.description: Gross revenue (total_amount) of completed delivery orders.

in_mall_orders.description: In-mall channel: order count / gross revenue / delivery fees.

line_items.description:
Units sold (SUM of order_items.quantity) across completed orders in
scope. Counts units, not distinct lines, matching the item-sales
reports ("3× burger" contributes 3).

outside_orders.description: Outside channel: order count / gross revenue / delivery fees.

brand_background.description:
The card palette derived from `logo_url` when it was uploaded
(`orgs::branding`). Read-only over the API: there is nothing to set, and
nothing a client may set — the point of deriving is that a shop cannot
choose two colours nobody can read.

tax_rate.description:
Tax rate as a decimal (e.g. `0.14` for 14% VAT).
Stored as `BigDecimal` internally; transmitted as a JSON number.

timezone.description:
IANA timezone name. The org-level default that branches inherit when
their own timezone is unset. Defaults to `Africa/Cairo`.

cost_per_unit.description:
Standard (org default) cost, piastres per unit. `null` ⟺ never entered
(unknown, NOT free) — recipes using this ingredient are cost-missing.

density_g_per_ml.description: Grams per millilitre, bridging weight↔volume in recipes; `null` = none.

pack_size.description: How many BASE STOCK units one `pack_unit` yields; `null` = none.

supplier_id.description: Default supplier for reordering this ingredient; `null` = none set.

stocktake_variance_threshold_pct.description:
Stock-count variance tolerance (percent). A counted row whose |difference|
is at least this percent of book stock is flagged and needs a reason.

visible_in_integrations.description:
When false, orders tendered with this method are excluded entirely
from the partner analytics API (`/integrations/analytics/orders`) —
rows and aggregates alike. Defaults to true.

amount_piastres.description:
The figure to charge instead of the computed one. Zero is allowed — it
means "charge nothing" while keeping the row and its history.

reason.description:
Required. An override with no stated reason is indistinguishable from a
mistake six months later.

units_per_purchase_unit.description:
Stock units per purchase unit. Ignored when `purchase_unit` is a known
inventory unit (the factor is derived from the ingredient's base unit).

PaginatedOrdersFull.description:
Same envelope as [PaginatedOrders] but each order carries its line items
(returned when `include_items=true`).

PassLinks.description:
What signup hands the customer. Either side may be absent: a tenant with only
Google credentials configured shows one button, not a broken one.

any.description:
False when neither wallet is configured — the site shows the member's
QR on the page instead of dead buttons.

apple_url.description:
Downloads the signed `.pkpass`. Site-relative, because the signup page
is served from the same origin as the API — so a pass needs a
CERTIFICATE, not a configured base URL.

PatchGroupRequest.description:
Every field optional — only present keys are updated. `Option<Option<T>>` (with
`deserialize_with`) is avoided; nullable columns that must be clearable
(`max_selections`) are handled by a dedicated presence flag pattern below.

PaymentLeg.description: One tender against an order (`order_payments`). A split sale has several.

original_amount_piastres.description:
What the RULE computed, before any human touched it. `None` on a
hand-entered row — nothing was overridden, so there is no "original".

waived_at.description: A waived deduction keeps its amount and stays visible; payroll skips it.

period_name.description:
The period this covers, denormalised. A payslip identified only by its
generation timestamp is unreadable — two months run on the same day would
be indistinguishable to the employee looking at them.

avg_orders_per_day.description: Orders averaged over the number of calendar days (may be fractional).

avg_revenue_per_day.description: Revenue in piastres averaged over the number of calendar days in the queried range.

orders_pct.description: This hour's orders as a percentage of the period total (0–100, 1 dp).

revenue_pct.description: This hour's revenue as a percentage of the period total (0–100, 1 dp).

Period.description:
The reporting window.

Prefer a [`PeriodPreset`]: it is resolved server-side against the merchant's
timezone at query time, which means a dashboard widget saying "last 30 days"
stays correct forever, and a language model never has to do calendar
arithmetic — historically the single largest source of wrong answers.

oneOf.description: A named relative window. Takes precedence over `from`/`to`.

PeriodInfo.description:
The resolved window, echoed so a client can label an answer without
re-deriving "last month" itself.

PeriodPreset.description: Named relative windows, resolved in the merchant's timezone.

PermissionMatrix.description:
One cell of the resolved permission matrix for a user.
`effective` = `user_override` if present, else `role_default`, else false.

extra_prep_minutes.description:
Minutes the teller adds on top of the branch base prep time. Must be a
non-negative multiple of 5.

PresenceRow.description: One person's state right now, for the manager's live team list.

scheduled_minutes.description:
Minutes this person is rostered for today — the denominator of the
labour-vs-plan bar.

grain.description:
Result shape, so a widget picker knows a KPI card from a line chart
before running anything.

permission.description: Permission resource required, with the `read` action.

PriceOverrideOut.description: The persisted override row (returned by the upsert).

today.description: Today's service date in the branch zone (the picker's floor).

device_token.description: From `/public/otp/verify`; required when the branch requires OTP.

PublicBookingView.description: What a guest sees on the manage page — no table ids, no staff fields.

can_modify.description: Still confirmed and further away than the branch's lead time.

in_mall_open_now.description: Effective-open right now (enabled + open shift + override + window).

in_mall_require_location.description: When false, in-mall ordering does not require a device GPS location.

otp_required.description: When false, the public checkout skips OTP verification for this branch.

PublicReward.description: A reward as the signup page lists it: what it is, and what it costs.

branch_name.description:
Branch label — populated by the order lists so the "All branches" view
can show which branch each PO belongs to; other endpoints leave it null.

addon_item_ids.description:
Full replacement set of addon item IDs allowed on this menu item.
Send an empty array to clear the restriction (falls back to org catalog).

PutEmployeeRequest.description:
Full replace of an employee's HR profile. A PUT rather than a POST because
the key is the user id: writing a profile for a user who has none promotes
them to staff, and writing it again edits them.

base_salary_piastres.description:
Piastres. Ignored unless the caller has `payroll:update` — a branch
manager editing a job title must not be able to award a raise.

work_shift_id.description: Omit (or send null) to mark the date an explicit day off.

steps.description: The whole list, in order. Replaces what was there.

items.description:
The complete list for this scope, in order. An empty list clears the
scope — for a branch that means going back to inheriting the org's.

branch_id.description: Omit for the org default; set for a branch override.

QrResponse.description: JSON returned from every QR-generation endpoint.

qr_data_url.description: `data:image/png;base64,…` (or `data:image/svg+xml;base64,…` when `svg=true`). Paste into a browser `` to verify.

branch.description:
Narrow to ONE branch by name. Fuzzy-matched *within* the caller's
accessible branches, so it can only ever narrow, never widen. Dashboards
use the request-level scope instead and leave this unset.

dataset.description: Dataset id — fixes the grain. See `GET /metrics/schema`.

dimensions.description: GROUP BY axes, outermost first. Empty = a single total row.

filters.description: Filter id → chosen value. Each value selects a pre-written predicate.

having_min.description: Only keep groups whose sort measure reaches this value.

measures.description: Aggregates to compute. Empty = the dataset's headline measures.

oneOf.description: Which measure orders the result, and in which direction.

Preferred visualization. Omitted or [`Viz::Auto`] lets the backend pick
from the result shape.

unit_cost.description:
Optional ACTUAL invoice cost (piastres per purchase unit) for this
delivery, when it differs from the ordered price. Drives weighted-average
cost + the ledger; omitted ⟹ the PO line's ordered cost is used.

RecipeCostResult.description: Result of a recipe replace: the recomputed size cost.

quantity.description: Submitted quantity (in `unit`); server normalizes to the ingredient base unit.

RecipeLineOut.description: One recipe line, hydrated with the ingredient name and a per-line cost.

line_cost_piastres.description:
Cost of this line in piastres. `null` = UNKNOWN (ingredient unlinked/uncosted),
never shown as 0. A priced line with `quantity = 0` (swap marker) costs 0.

quantity.description: Base-unit, yield-normalized quantity, serialized as a string (numeric fidelity).

RecipeStep.description:
One step, resolved for display: whatever its kind, it has a name, and a
preset step also carries its note and the animation to play.

animation_url.description:
Present only for a preset whose animation still ships. `None` on a
custom step, and on a retired preset — clients show the name alone.

name.description: The preset's name, or the typed name of a custom step.

preset_slug.description: The preset this step uses, if any.

title.description: The typed name, for `custom`. Either language will do.

RecipeStepPreset.description: One curated step the dashboard offers.

animation_url.description: Path to the animation, relative to the API base.

RegistryInfo.description: The complete registry, as served to a dashboard.

boards.description: Built-in dashboard layouts a merchant can use or fork.

ReorderLine.description:
One ingredient to reorder, with the quantity needed to reach its order-up-to
level (par_max, else the reorder point).

suggested_qty.description: Quantity (in base units) to bring stock up to the order-up-to level.

ReorderSuggestion.description:
Reorder suggestions grouped by the ingredient's default supplier so the
dashboard can raise one draft PO per supplier.

RepricingReport.description: The repricing surface for a branch (or org-wide).

skus_considered.description: Active priced SKUs considered in total.

skus_cost_unknown.description:
Active priced SKUs whose cost is not fully known — NOT suggested (no
guessed cost); surfaced so coverage is transparent.

suggestions.description: Underpriced SKUs with a target-restoring suggestion, biggest uplift first.

RepricingSuggestion.description:
One repricing suggestion: an underpriced SKU + the price that would restore
the target margin.

below_cost.description: True when the item currently sells BELOW cost (negative margin).

suggested_price.description: Target-restoring price `ceil(cost / (1 − target))` to whole EGP, piastres.

target_pct.description: The org/branch target margin this suggestion aims for.

is_paid.description:
Whether the excused time is paid. Applies to `excuse` and
`early_departure`; omitted falls back to the org's
`excused_time_paid_default`.

distance_meters.description: Straight-line distance from the supplied coordinates to the branch, in metres.

ResolvedShift.description:
A work shift resolved onto a concrete calendar date, with its window already
converted to UTC instants.

ResultBlock.description:
One dataset the assistant pulled while answering. A turn may carry several —
"compare this month to last" is two.

spec.description:
The exact query that produced this. Sending it back is what makes
"pin this answer to my dashboard" a single client-side action: the spec
is already a valid widget definition.

title.description: Set when the data came from a curated metric.

quantity.description: Base stock units to return (must be ≤ on hand).

unit_cost.description: Piastres per base stock unit; defaults to the branch's actual cost.

inherited.description: True when these rows are the org default rather than this branch's own.

base_price.description: Menu price in piastres — what the reward is worth, for the admin's sake.

cost_amount.description:
How much of that currency it costs. Per item, so one catalogue holds
"espresso, 5 visits" beside "cake, 10 visits".

cost_currency.description: `"points"` or `"visits"` — what this reward is bought with.

name.description: Denormalised for display so the teller and the pass need no menu join.

cost_currency.description: `"points"` or `"visits"`. Omitted follows the scope's mode.

effective.description: What actually applies right now (auto resolves to kds-if-stations-else-till).

mode.description: Stored override (`kds` | `till` | `both`), or null when auto.

ScanResult.description: What the teller's scan screen shows.

recent.description: Recent history, so a teller can answer "where did my points go?".

rewards.description:
What this member could claim at this branch right now. Empty until the
balance reaches the threshold, so the screen cannot tempt a teller into
handing over a reward that has not been earned.

day_of_week.description:
Postgres `EXTRACT(DOW)` convention: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday.
`None` = every day of the week.

ScheduledDay.description: One day of an employee's own upcoming roster.

branch_name.description: The branch each shift is worked at, when the employee has one assignment.

ScopeInfo.description:
Which branches an answer actually covers. Returned on every response so the
scope of a number is never ambiguous — "all branches" versus one of them is
the difference between a figure being right and being off by a factor of
however many branches the merchant has.

all_branches.description: True when the answer spans every branch the caller can access.

label.description: Human-readable label, e.g. "All branches (3)" or "Sidi Henish".

unmatched_branch.description:
Set when a branch was named but could not be matched. The answer then
falls back to the full accessible set, and this flags the mismatch rather
than silently answering a different question.

table_ids.description:
Seat the party on these tables instead (a walk-in took theirs, or the
host prefers another). Omit to keep the claim.

SetParRequest.description: Par levels for one ingredient at one branch. `null` clears a level.

mode.description: `kds` | `till` | `both`, or null to clear the override (back to auto).

discount_id.description: Settle-time overrides (else the ticket's own discount / no tip).

loyalty_customer_id.description: The member spending a balance on this settle, when rewards are applied.

loyalty_redemptions.description:
Rewards covering lines of the ticket. A table-service bill redeems
exactly like a counter one — the cashier scans at settle either way.

branch_name.description:
Branch label — only populated by the shifts list (so the "All branches"
view can show which branch each shift belongs to). Other shift endpoints
leave it `null`.

till_id.description:
The till (drawer) this shift is on. Populated by the read/list/open
endpoints; mutation responses that build the row via RETURNING may leave
`till_name` null (same convention as `branch_name`).

cash_movements_net.description: Net of all cash movements (in - out) as a signed integer

cash_tips.description:
The cash slice of `total_tips` (snapshotted `tip_is_cash`). This IS in
the drawer, so it is counted by `expected_cash` even though it is not
part of `net_payments`.

expected_cash.description:
Authoritative system (expected) cash in the drawer. For a closed shift
this is the snapshot taken at close (`closing_cash_system`); for an open
shift it is computed live via the same formula. Clients should display
this directly instead of re-deriving it from the payment breakdown.

non_cash_tips.description: `total_tips - cash_tips` — tips added onto a card/wallet tender.

payment_summary.description:
Money COLLECTED FOR GOODS, bucketed by the method actually tendered
(`order_payments`, so a split order contributes to each leg it really
used). Tips are NOT in here — see `total_tips`.

total_tips.description:
Tips, as a standalone figure — never folded into a method bucket, and
never part of `total_payments`/`net_payments`. Mirrors `total_tips` on
the sales reports so the two screens agree on what "revenue" means.

revenue_by_method.description: Goods only, by method actually tendered. Tips are in `total_tips`.

reason.description: The variance reason captured at finalize, or `unexplained` when none.

shrinkage_qty.description: Quantity lost (positive number) from negative stock-count differences.

shrinkage_value.description: Valued shrinkage in piastres; `null` when any contributing cost unknown.

Signal.description:
One advisory flag on a ledger row. `params` carries the evidence numbers the
client templates into a localized reason; `link` names the fix surface.

kind.description:
below_cost | below_target | cost_spike | price_candidate |
removal_candidate | recipe_incomplete

SizeCostOut.description: Live per-size cost of an item from the NEW tables.

cost_piastres.description:
Recipe cost rollup in piastres. `null` = unknown (no priced ingredient),
never 0. A partial rollup returns the sum-so-far with `cost_incomplete=true`.

SizeOut.description: A size (menu_item_sizes row) with its recipe and live cost.

cost_incomplete.description:
`true` when at least one recipe line is unlinked/uncosted (so `cost_piastres`, if
present, is a partial figure rather than the full COGS).

cost_piastres.description:
Recipe cost rollup in piastres over the priced ingredients. `null` when there is
no recipe or nothing is priced; a partial rollup returns the sum-so-far with
`cost_incomplete = true`.

SizeOverrideOut.description: Per-branch/channel availability & price overrides for a single size.

price.description: Override price in piastres; `null` = inherit the catalog default.

SkuCost.description: Computed cost for one sellable SKU (menu item × size).

cost.description:
Recipe cost rollup in piastres over the ingredients that *are* priced.
`null` only when there is no recipe, or no recipe ingredient has a known
cost at all. A partial rollup (some ingredients unpriced) still returns
the sum so far, with `cost_missing = true` flagging it as incomplete.

cost_missing.description:
`true` when at least one recipe ingredient is unlinked or has no cost, so
`cost` (if any) is a partial figure rather than the full COGS.

food_cost_pct.description: `cost / price` — only when the cost is *complete* and price > 0.

margin_pct.description:
`(price - cost) / price` — only when the cost is *complete* and price > 0.
Suppressed (`null`) for partial rollups so an incomplete cost is never
graded as a food-cost percentage.

price.description: Current price in piastres for this SKU.

size_label.description: `"one_size"` when the item has no sizes.

table_ids.description:
The tables the auto-assigner would pick (host view only; empty when
unavailable).

attendance_record_id.description: The record a `correction` proposes to fix. `None` for every other kind.

end_date.description: Set for `leave` and `mission`; the span's last day.

from_time.description: Start of the excused window. `None` = open to the shift's start.

is_paid.description: Whether the excused time is paid. `None` until decided.

to_time.description: End of the excused window. `None` = open to the shift's end.

status.description:
Target line step: "confirmed" | "preparing" | "ready" | "out_for_delivery".
The teller may jump to ANY of these from any non-terminal state (forward or
back); the landed step is stamped and all other step stamps are cleared, and
at most one customer WhatsApp fires (the last newly-crossed step that has one).

branch_name.description:
Branch name; only populated by the all-branches waste roll-up (nil
{branch_id}). `None` for single-branch queries that do not select it.

movement_type.description:
inventory_movement_type: sale | void_restock | adjustment_add |
adjustment_remove | waste | transfer_out | transfer_in | purchase_in |
purchase_return | stock_count

quantity.description: Signed delta applied to stock (consumption negative, replenishment positive).

unit_cost.description: Piastres per unit at movement time; `null` ⟺ unknown.

cost_per_unit.description: Piastres per unit; `null` ⟺ cost never entered.

par_min.description: Reorder point; `null` = not set at this branch.

branch_name.description:
Branch label — only populated by the stocktakes list (so the "All
branches" view can show which branch each stocktake belongs to).

counted_items.description: Items counted / items in scope; populated by the list endpoint only.

variance_threshold_pct.description:
Org tolerance: a counted row whose |difference| is >= this percent of
book stock (or that appears-from / vanishes-to zero) is flagged and
requires a `variance_reason` before the count can be finalized.

book_qty.description:
The baseline the difference is measured against: live book stock while
the count is open, frozen at finalize.

is_new.description:
True when the branch had no stock activity for this ingredient when the
count opened — counting it is what starts tracking it here.

opening_qty.description: Book stock when the count was opened (reference only).

variance_reason.description: theft | spoilage | breakage | miscount | supplier_short | transfer_error | other.

specs.description:
The queries that produced the answer — `[{title, preset_id, spec}]`.
Re-running these is how a reopened conversation shows CURRENT figures
rather than the numbers that were true when it was first asked.

StudioAggregate.description: The full item aggregate the one-page Menu Studio editor renders.

recipe_steps.description:
How the item is made, in order. Edited through `PUT /recipes/steps/{id}`
and saved by the studio alongside the recipe lines.

SyncIngredient.description: An org ingredient referenced by a returned option recipe.

SyncItem.description: One menu item with its sizes and attached modifier groups.

SyncModifierGroup.description:
A modifier group attached to an item, with min/max/required resolved from the
attachment overrides (falling back to the group defaults).

name.description:
The group's authored display name (custom groups have no legacy type —
this is what the POS renders as the section title).

SyncOption.description: A modifier option, with price/availability resolved for `(branch, channel)`.

price.description: Effective price in piastres (branch_channel → branch → channel → catalog default).

replaces_ingredient_id.description: The org_ingredient this option swaps out, if it is a swap-style option.

SyncRecipeLine.description:
One recipe line of a modifier option: which ingredient the option deducts
(or swaps in, when `quantity = 0`). Base-unit, yield-normalized values.

quantity.description: Base-unit quantity, serialized as a string for numeric fidelity.

SyncSize.description:
A size (menu_item_sizes row) with its price/availability resolved for the
requested `(branch, channel)`.

price.description: Effective price in piastres (branch_channel → branch → channel → catalog default).

TableBookingHint.description: The slice of a booking the floor needs to show a held/reserved table.

held_from.description: `starts_at - hold_minutes`: from here the table reads as held.

TablePosition.description:
One table's geometry in a bulk drag-save. `section_id` lets a drag move a
table between sections in the same save.

expected_updated_at.description:
Optimistic-concurrency token: the `updated_at` the client last saw for
this table.

The dashboard autosaves every gesture, so two managers arranging the
same room no longer collide rarely and visibly -- they collide often and
silently, each overwriting the other's last drag. When this is sent, the
write only lands if the row has not moved since; otherwise the whole
request is rejected and the caller is told exactly which tables changed.

Optional so existing clients (and the POS) keep working unchanged: absent
means "no guard", which is the previous last-write-wins behaviour.

TeamPresence.description: The whole team's state right now, plus the day's labour against plan.

business_date.description: The branch's business date, in ITS timezone — not the manager's device.

planned_minutes.description: Minutes rostered for today across the team.

worked_minutes.description: Minutes actually worked so far today across the team.

dimension.description: Which of the chosen dimensions to rank within.

n.description: How many rows to keep per group.

occupant_kind.description:
Always `open_ticket`. Kept on the wire so the rebuilt booking flow
can queue into the same waitlist without a schema change.

occupant_label.description: Display label for the queue: the held order's name / the ticket's ref.

cumulative.description: Add a running total in time order. Needs a time dimension.

share.description: Add each row's percentage of the grand total.

oneOf.description:
Keep only the top N rows *within* each value of a dimension — "the best
seller in every branch".

force.description: Keep the booking when no table fits after a move (default true).

table_ids.description: Present = reassign to exactly these tables (empty = unassign).

UpdateBranchRequest.description:
PATCH-style update. Fields fall into three categories:

- **Absent** from JSON → keep existing value.
- **Present as `null`** (only the `printer_*` fields) → clear the column.
- **Present as a value** → set to that value.

OpenAPI cannot express the absent-vs-null distinction cleanly, so all
fields are documented as optional and nullable. Clients targeting this
endpoint should send only the fields they want to change.

available_from_time.description:
`null`  → clear the field (no start time restriction)
omitted → keep the existing value
a value → set to that time

logo_url.description:
`null` clears the logo; absent leaves it unchanged. To set a new
logo, use `PUT /orgs/{id}/logo` (multipart) instead — JSON updates
only accept the clear-to-null case here.

timezone.description:
IANA timezone name (e.g. `Africa/Cairo`). Validated against the
PostgreSQL timezone database. Branches inherit this when their own
timezone is unset.

oneOf.description:
Only org-admins and above can change roles. Promoting to
`super_admin` requires the caller to be a super-admin.

image.description: Image file. PNG, JPEG, or WebP. Required.

logo.description: Logo image file. PNG, JPEG, or WebP. Required.

value.description: on_hand × cost_per_unit in piastres; `null` when cost unknown.

net_variance_value.description: overage − shrinkage (net effect on inventory value).

total_shrinkage_value.description: Piastres lost to shrinkage (negative variances), as a positive number.

unknown_cost_count.description: Count of counted rows whose cost was unknown (excluded from totals).

book_qty.description: Book stock the difference is measured against (at finalize).

is_flagged.description: True when |difference| exceeds the org threshold (or appears/vanishes from zero).

opening_qty.description: Book stock when the count opened.

variance_value.description: variance × unit_cost in piastres; `null` when cost unknown.

Viz.description:
How a result is best visualized. A hint: the client may always override, and
[`Viz::Auto`] asks the backend to choose from the [`Grain`].

WaiterStats.description:
Per-waiter sales split. Only waiter-attributed orders appear (dine-in
settled from a waiter's ticket — `orders.waiter_id IS NOT NULL`); direct
teller sales and delivery orders are out of scope, so totals here are a
subset of the branch overview. `attributed_orders`/`attributed_revenue`
on the report envelope let the UI caption that gap.

avg_items_per_order.description: line_items / orders; 0 when the waiter has no non-voided orders.

line_items.description:
Units sold (SUM of order_items.quantity) on this waiter's non-voided
orders — the upsell signal behind avg_items_per_order.

WaiterStatsReport.description:
Envelope for the waiters split: rows plus the branch-level totals needed
to caption coverage ("X of Y orders came through waiters").

attributed_orders.description: Non-voided orders in range that carry a waiter.

total_orders.description: All non-voided orders in range (waiter or not).

WhatsappStatus.description:
Snapshot returned to the dashboard. Combines the gateway's live link state
with the backend's persisted pause switch.

connected.description: Underlying socket is connected to WhatsApp.

has_qr.description: A pairing QR is currently available to scan.

logged_in.description: A number is linked and ready to send.

paused.description:
Sending is paused by an admin — the number stays linked but every
outbound message (OTP + status) is suppressed until resumed.

qr_image.description: Current pairing QR as a `data:image/png;base64,…` URL (only when `has_qr`).

reachable.description: The gateway answered over HTTP (false = not configured or unreachable).

session.description: Session name the relay pairs/sends under.

WidgetOutcome.description:
A widget either produced a result or an explanation. Never both, never
neither — and a failure here is a 200 with an `error`, not a failed batch.

WidgetRequest.description: One widget in a batch. Exactly one of `preset` or `spec`.

key.description: Caller-chosen key, echoed back so results can be matched to widgets.

oneOf.description: Overrides the batch-level period for this widget alone.
A fully custom query. Same IR the AI agent produces.

branch_id.description: `None` = an org-wide template usable at any branch.

crosses_midnight.description: Derived by the database from `end_time <= start_time`.

basic_integration.description: Partner analytics credential issued from the dashboard (`POST /integrations/credentials`). Send as `Authorization: Basic base64(username:secret)`. Read-only and scoped to a single branch.

bearer_jwt.description: JWT obtained from `POST /auth/login` (email/password) or `POST /auth/pin-login` (teller PIN). Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
